title: Rebuild thinking blocks in streamed Anthropic responses

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1057] Rebuild `thinking` and `redacted_thinking` blocks in streamed `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#chat` responses instead of leaving `nil` in the content, which made `chat_completion` raise `NoMethodError` whenever Claude thought (by default on Claude 5 models).
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1056] Format `PromptTemplate` and the `FewShotPromptTemplate` suffix in a single pass, so escaped `{{braces}}` stay literal, an inserted value is never expanded as another variable, and backslashes in values (`\'`, `\0`, `\&`) are kept as-is.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1055] Stop sending the default `temperature` (0.0) from `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#chat`; Claude Opus 4.7+ and Sonnet 5+ reject it with a 400. A temperature set in `default_options` or passed to `#chat` is still sent.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1052] Return every `tool_use` block from `AnthropicResponse#tool_calls` instead of only the first, so parallel tool calls from Claude are no longer silently dropped.

+    # Rebuilds a thinking block from its deltas. The signature is kept so the block
+    # can be passed back unchanged on a later turn.
+    def thinking_block_from_chunks(chunks, block_type)
+      if block_type == "redacted_thinking"
+        start = chunks.find { |chunk| chunk["type"] == "content_block_start" }
+        return {type: "redacted_thinking", data: start.dig("content_block", "data")}
+      end
+
+      {
+        type: "thinking",
+        thinking: chunks.map { |chunk| chunk.dig("delta", "thinking") }.join,
+        signature: chunks.map { |chunk| chunk.dig("delta", "signature") }.join
+      }
+    end
+
     def tool_calls_from_choice_chunks(chunks)
       return unless (first_block = chunks.find { |chunk| chunk.dig("content_block", "type") == "tool_use" })

+    context "with streaming and a thinking block" do
+      let(:fixture) { File.read("spec/fixtures/llm/anthropic/chat_stream_with_thinking.json") }
+      let(:response) { JSON.parse(fixture) }
+      let(:stream_handler) { proc { _1 } }
+
+      before do
+        allow(subject.client.messages).to receive(:create) do |parameters|
+          response.each do |chunk|
+            parameters[:stream].call(chunk)
+          end
+        end
+      end
+
+      it "returns the text after the thinking block" do
+        rsp = subject.chat(messages: messages, &stream_handler)
+        expect(rsp.chat_completion).to eq("Life is pretty good")
+        expect(rsp.tool_calls).to eq([])
+      end
+
+      it "keeps the thinking block with its signature" do
+        rsp = subject.chat(messages: messages, &stream_handler)
+        expect(rsp.chat_completions.first).to eq(
+          {type: "thinking", thinking: "The user is greeting me.", signature: "EqQBCgIYAhIM"}
+        )
+      end
+    end
+
